title: Terraform Examples
description: Small Terraform examples from the lessons. Each example links back to its explanation and practice task.

examples.title: Configuration before action
examples.description: Infrastructure as code means describing resources in files. Terraform reads those files and compares the desired result with recorded state.

examples.title: A local resource example
examples.description: terraform_data is a built-in resource that stores an input in Terraform state. It does not create a cloud machine.

examples.title: Initialise the folder
examples.description: init prepares a working directory. Backend configuration controls where state is stored; this practice keeps remote backends disabled.

examples.title: Format and validate
examples.description: fmt checks or rewrites formatting. validate checks whether the configuration is internally valid after needed initialization.

examples.title: Variables accept inputs
examples.description: A variable declares an input and can provide a default. Types make the expected kind of value clear.

examples.title: Outputs show selected values
examples.description: An output exposes a useful result from the configuration. It does not automatically make a private value safe to publish.

examples.title: Read a plan
examples.description: plan describes proposed changes. It gives you a chance to review before choosing whether to apply.

examples.title: State records managed resources
examples.description: State links configuration to managed objects and their data. It can contain sensitive information, so treat it as important private project data.
examples.code:
Configuration: what you want
State: what Terraform recorded
Provider reads: what exists now

examples.title: Local values name expressions
examples.description: locals name calculated values used inside a configuration. They are not inputs supplied from outside like variables.

examples.title: References express dependencies
examples.description: A reference to another resource's result tells Terraform about a dependency. It can then choose a valid order of work.

examples.title: Modules package configuration
examples.description: A module is a group of Terraform configuration files used together. The current folder is the root module; other modules can be called from it.
examples.code:
Root module
  -> local module for a repeated group of settings
Module inputs: variables
Module results: outputs

examples.title: Separate review from applying
examples.description: apply performs the reviewed changes. A safe workflow checks scope, target and the exact plan before changing any real resources.
examples.code:
Read configuration
Check working directory and state target
Validate and plan
Review proposed effects
Apply only when authorised
